slug: 2026-06-17 Seacom deploys a new high-capacity Nairobi–Kampala route to strengthen East Africa's digital backbone

facts.fact: Seacom states that traffic moves inland from subsea cable landing stations in Mombasa, Kenya, over its Nairobi-Kisumu-Kampala route launched 17 June 2026; no cable is named.

note: Terrestrial inland route; the only international-route statement is the Mombasa landing reference.
